items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: Was there a distinction with you guys in the listening end of it between Bunk Johnson type black jazz and white players?

ctx.x: Was there a distinction with you guys in the listening end of it between Bunk Johnson type black jazz and white players? Was there any distinction?

No. There really wasn’t. In fact, because my introduction to it, if you will, was through the bands who were playing Dixieland and traditional jazz in the late 40s and 50s, I really didn’t pay much attention to the earlier stuff.
